billing.title: Billing and Refund Policy
billing.policy: For billing questions, verify the transaction details and subscription status before advising the customer. Duplicate charges and refund requests must be reviewed by a support agent. Do not promise a refund before eligibility is confirmed.

account_access.title: Account Access Policy
account_access.policy: For account access issues, guide the customer to the official password recovery process. Never ask the customer to share their password or authentication codes. Escalate suspected account compromise to a human support agent.

technical.title: Technical Support Policy
technical.policy: For technical issues, ask for the error message and relevant troubleshooting details. Suggest basic troubleshooting where appropriate. Escalate persistent errors, service outages, and issues that could affect customer data.

other.title: General Support Policy
other.policy: For general enquiries, provide clear and helpful information when it is available. If the request cannot be answered confidently, route it to a human support agent.
